snippet.title: Slightly Used Sorcery – Early Access Trailer | Cozy Magic Shop Sim
snippet.description:
Run a cozy second-hand magic shop where every curse has a customer. Slightly Used Sorcery comes to Steam Early Access on November 17, 2026.

Wishlist on Steam and try the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4718660/Slightly_Used_Sorcery/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=ea_trailer

Buy suspicious junk, uncover ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, and haggle with eccentric customers who pay premium prices for magical nonsense.

Arrange and grow your shop, explore the town and Night Market, race geese, and deal with a demanding Golden Goose. Your next magical mistake might be your most profitable discovery.

Watch the official Early Access gameplay trailer for Slightly Used Sorcery.

Press and creator enquiries: vkoval.de
